scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev
scripts.db:up: pnpm env:init && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml up -d --wait
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm db:up && dotenv -e .env -- go -C apps/api run ./cmd/server migrate
scripts.db:seed: pnpm db:migrate && dotenv -e .env -- go -C apps/api run ./cmd/seed
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml down --volumes && pnpm db:seed
